title: Add an --uppercase option to greet
objective: Add an uppercase option to the greet package: greet/config.py's DEFAULTS gains "uppercase": False; greet/formatter.py's format_greeting returns the whole greeting upper-cased when cfg["uppercase"] is true; greet/cli.py gains an --uppercase flag that turns it on. Add tests for the new behaviour under tests/.
done_when: python3 -m greet.cli --uppercase Ada prints HELLO, ADA!, output without the flag is unchanged, python3 -m unittest discover passes including the new tests, and the change is committed.
